content.short: Neverland is a Monad lending platform built around sustainable incentive design.
content.description: Neverland runs lending markets on Monad with an incentive structure intended to hold up after the initial emissions period, rather than relying on token rewards to attract deposits that leave when those rewards taper. That pattern has repeated often enough across chain launches to make the design question a reasonable one to lead with.
content.meta: Monad lending designed to hold up once the initial emissions period tapers off.
